text: Su-mi [comes home|trigger|going back home] from a mental institution to her family's secluded country house with her younger sister Su-yeon, to a distant father and a stepmother, Eun-joo, who once nursed their dying mother. Su-mi finds [bruises on Su-yeon's arms|wrong|harm done to children] and blames Eun-joo, while a wardrobe frightens Su-yeon and [their mother's ghost walks in their nightmares|threat|the restless dead]. As pet birds die and a bloodied sack is dragged through the house, [what Su-mi sees begins to slip|rules|reality comes apart].
